critical_code_review_comments: Repeating hydration console error: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>' emitted from src/components/MiraDayOffer.jsx (~line 55). React 18/19 hydrates option elements without allowing children other than plain text; the current markup uses <span data-ve-dynamic> wrappers inside <option>. This is a pre-existing but noisy warning that fires on every page mount that includes the Dashboard MiraDayOffer widget. Should render option labels as raw strings.

AdminLockScreen (used for /staff and /settings when the ADMIN role visits them) shows a heading 'Sorry, you're not authorized' via ManagerLockScreen wording in some contexts and 'Staff is protected / Enter your Owner PIN' in others — copy is inconsistent between ManagerLockScreen.jsx and AdminLockScreen.jsx. Consider aligning the copy so owners don't see 'not authorized' when they simply need to enter the Owner PIN.

NewAppointmentModal service picker has no data-testid on the multi-select for services (only appt-customer-select, appt-staff-select, appt-datetime-input, save-appt-btn). Add a data-testid like 'appt-services-select' or per-service 'appt-service-<id>' to make E2E booking creation reliably scriptable.

The ADMIN_LOCKED gate stores the unlock in sessionStorage per (userId, path). Reloading a tab after admin-pin-unlock keeps the section unlocked, which is the intended shared-device UX; the visible copy however says 're-locks on refresh' in comments — align comment and behaviour.

Several pages still ship 404/403 background fetches on load (/refer, /staff-activities, /offers-studio, /inventory) — non-blocking but pollutes DevTools; consider gating those calls behind role/feature flags.
